# Frontend Design Skill

## Core Directives
- Avoid generic "purple-gradient-on-white" AI defaults.
- Enforce bold typography, structured spacing (use consistent rem/em values).
- Utilize cohesive, subtle animation choices instead of jarring transitions.
- Maintain WCAG contrast compliance.

## Execution Rules
1. Before styling, determine the layout grid and spacing scale.
2. Select an appropriate typographic hierarchy and document it.
3. Apply structural component design rather than inline magic numbers.
